sections.label: Our Teams

briefs.headline: Chelsea close the pre-season 3-1 over Real Sociedad
briefs.summary: Saturday's win was the last warm-up before the season opens Friday. Chelsea beat AC Milan 3-0 on Aug. 8 and drew 3-3 with Johor Darul Ta'zim the day after.

briefs.headline: Tottenham beat Hoffenheim 3-0, and meet them again
briefs.summary: Saturday's win follows a 1-1 draw with Getafe on Aug. 8. The clubs play a second time Sunday behind closed doors before the Aug. 21 start.

briefs.headline: Browns lose the preseason opener 34-10 at Chicago
briefs.summary: Cleveland led 10-0 before Chicago scored 24 unanswered. Deshaun Watson went 11 of 15 for 126 yards in his first game in nearly two years; Shedeur Sanders threw an interception.

briefs.headline: Miami turn Friday around and beat the Reds 8-4
briefs.summary: Cincinnati had taken the previous night 1-0. Tyler Zuber took the decision to go to 2-1; Tejay Antone fell to 2-1.

briefs.headline: Sonny Gray shuts out the Pirates 4-0
briefs.summary: Boston's starter went to 15-3 with a 2.65 ERA. Jared Jones took the loss and fell to 2-5, a night after Pittsburgh put up eight on the same club.

sections.label: Around the Leagues

briefs.headline: Nashville beat Inter Miami 4-1 and hold first place
briefs.summary: Hany Mukhtar scored twice and Messi missed a penalty in the 23rd minute. Nashville move to 43 points, five clear of Miami, whose seven-match unbeaten run ends.

briefs.headline: The Premier League season opens Friday
briefs.summary: The 2026-27 campaign begins Aug. 21, and Arsenal meet Manchester City in the Community Shield at Cardiff on Sunday. Until Friday the football beat is friendlies and transfers.

sections.note: MLB produced 15 results on Saturday and none of them moved a division, so none are carried here. Saturday's NFL preseason games were available only from aggregators this desk does not cite.

notes.item: Flounder is closed in North Carolina coastal waters and unlawful to possess. Topsail Sound is coastal water, so Marine Fisheries governs it, not the inland digest.
Nothing else opens within two weeks. The first general season is squirrel on Sept. 12, with a youth weekend Sept. 5-6.
Goose, duck, dove, woodcock and snipe dates are not in the summary table. They come from a separate WVDNR migratory bird publication issued in August, and HIP registration is required.

sections.standing_note: The pamphlet is a summary. The West Virginia Code and the Code of State Rules control and win any conflict. Dates here are for the 2026-27 season year and expire June 30, 2027. The North Carolina limits were checked against the Division of Marine Fisheries page this morning and are effective July 1, 2026.

sections.label: On the Water

waters.working: Down from 179 cfs on Friday and lower again, so the pocket water and plunge pools are the whole river. Long leader and a small caddis dry, with a light stonefly nymph through the deeper pockets and a sculpin pattern tight to the undercut banks.

waters.near: 14 miles above R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 25.1 ft — normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Normal pool fishes structure. Shad are the forage, so a white swimbait along the wing dams and the riprap, and a crawfish-coloured crankbait tight to the rock.

waters.near: below R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 27.4 ft — up and pushing. Expect colour and current; fish the slack behind anything solid.
waters.working: Up and coloured, so the fish are off the main current. Work the slack behind the wing dams, the barge cuts and the lock wall rather than the open channel.

waters.reading: Sound high 11:50 AM at Hampstead; lows 5:51 AM and 6:14 PM.
waters.read: Fish the moving water either side of high at 11:50 AM in the sound.
waters.working: Tide first: the push into the 11:50 a.m. high and the fall behind it are the windows, and it is a single high in daylight today. Mud minnows, shrimp and finger mullet are the forage, so work the grass edges and the oyster bars through the moving water.
waters.note: Hampstead is the sound station and is the read that matters; the oceanfront station at Ocean City Beach pier runs over an hour ahead and is quoted only for a surf read. No water temperature is carried today - the Wrightsville Beach gauge returned none.

sections.note: USGS does not gauge the Ohio at R.C. Byrd, and the Corps tailwater data is not reachable from this pipeline. The two gauges above are the ones that bracket the dam, and neither is the tailwater.
